answer: Anchor every agent to one vertex in a shared reputation graph, tied to basalt-hard proof of unique hardware: one device, one vertex. A newcomer joins only by locking a refundable bond and completing work that established agents attest to. Reputation flows like a river, downstream from trusted vertices to new ones, and only through real completed tasks. A sybil operator can spawn thousands of fake vertices, but without hardware anchors, bonds, and incoming attestation flow they stay dry tributaries: no reputation, no paid work, no vote, while each fake identity costs a bond and a device.
